results.title: Cursed Hearse
results.overview: When a down on his luck hipster buys an old hearse with the hopes of converting it into a limousine service, he soon finds out that there's a lot more to the hearse than he bargained for .

results.title: Red Crown
results.overview: Twenty-five contestants compete for a P25 million cash prize at the 25th-anniversary "Queen of the Islands" pageant.

results.title: Memburu Pemangsa
results.overview: Following a localized string of youth abductions and homicides, a cynical newspaper editor forms a desperate alliance with a law enforcement officer and three investigative journalists to track a missing child, uncovering a malevolent force that forces them to choose between self-preservation and lethal sacrifice.

results.title: He’s Dating a Boldstar
results.overview: Jeboy, a mild-mannered hotel employee, falls for a woman he believes is an ordinary guest—until he discovers she is a “bold star,” a Filipino term for an adult entertainer.

results.title: Recorded 2
results.overview: On October 16th, 2023, Georgina Reagan and her driver Petar Petrov went missing. Only Reagan's Canon EOS 90D camera was found. The fates of both Reagan and Petrov remain unknown. This is what happened next.

results.title: Pulp: What Do You Do for an Encore?
results.original_title: Pulp: What Do You Do for an Encore?
results.overview: A fusion of the brilliantly choreographed stage spectacle of Pulp’s biggest ever arena show — part of the global tour for More, the band’s first album in 24 years — with four decades of colorful, never-seen-before archival material.

results.title: Our Erika
results.overview: The inspiring journey of Estonian track bicycle racer Erika Salumäe, as she navigates the pressures of fame, personal sacrifice, and national pride, redefining resilience in the pursuit of her Olympic dreams.

results.title: Lau Chu Hoa: The Deadliest Mansion
results.overview: In the early 20th century, the daughter of a wealthy family in Saigon met a tragic end in the family's grand estate. Though her death was officially declared as an accident, the rumors of a woman in white, seen weeping by the old window of the mansion late at night, begin to spread.

results.title: Sasquatch Within
results.overview: Two assassins awaken trapped in a sealed apartment with one hour left and orders to kill each other. As memory and paranoia return, an ancient legend stirs- summoned by trauma- forcing them to face control, loyalty, and what lives within.

results.title: Mendocino
results.overview: A lawyer faces ancestral violence and haunting memories in a California farmhouse, exploring guilt and redemption.

results.title: National Seating
results.overview: Pleas Everson Sr. waxes poetically about his history of employment.

results.title: From the Ashes: The Pit
results.overview: Trapped in an underground pit during a storm, three students from an all-girls school must confront their personal conflicts as they fight to survive.

results.title: S4: The Bob Lazar Story
results.overview: Over 35 years after Bob Lazar's revelations, this documentary exposes secrets of a facility the government still denies. Featuring Lazar's testimony, recreations, and new evidence, it reopens a case that continues to spark global curiosity

results.title: Thai Fighters
results.original_title: สิงห์เหนือ เสือใต้
results.overview: The story begins in two villages facing each other across a river in Thailand’s central region, once as close as family but now bitter rivals who haven’t wanted to look each other in the eye for over a decade. Pride chokes them—whoever gives in first is the loser. Then matters of the heart, wounded masculinity, and a fierce competition enter the picture, fanning the flames even higher. Just as the conflict between the two villages reaches its boiling point, a hidden threat begins to creep in, slowly and quietly, catching everyone off guard.

results.title: Harrison Prime
results.overview: After taking drastic measures to allow enough time and energy for all of his obligations, Harrison struggles to feel whole.

results.title: I'll Be Seeing You
results.overview: When a work errand derails Amy's weekend plans with her grandma, they embark on a road trip with one sentimental detour but need the help of a charming activities director.

results.title: Bad Lieutenant: Tokyo
results.original_title: バッド・ルーテナント：トウキョウ
results.overview: A corrupt gambler in the Metropolitan Police Force finds himself thrown into a tangled case after an enigmatic FBI agent arrives in Tokyo to investigate the disappearance of a politician’s daughter.

results.title: Michael Che: Shot in Minnesota
results.overview: Michael Che takes aim at racism, marriage, free speech and everything in between.
